findings.description: Rounding logic fails for exact half-cent ties. The contract specifies that ties (remainder == 5) must be rounded upward, but the implementation only adds one cent when remainder > 5, leaving remainder == 5 unrounded.
findings.evidence: For input mills = 15, quotient = 1 and remainder = 5. Expected output per spec: 2 (rounded up). Candidate returns 1.

review.summary: Candidate implementation does not correctly round half-cent ties upward; when the remainder is exactly 5 mills, it rounds down instead of up, violating the contract.
